reading: Within the declared catalog-anchored sensitivity field, using energy only after movement and topology ties lowers the six-step destination energy index by 36.20% while leaving the primary 3-ray/1-hop movement floor unchanged. boundary: The point-to-site assignment and catalog energy figures are declared simulation inputs, not live telemetry and not intrinsic finite geometry.
